entries.source: Regesten der Pfalzgrafen am Rhein 1214 \- 1508: Karlsr. Coph. 466,86r.
entries.german: Ruprecht schuldet Conrad von Rosenberg, vitztum zu Heidelberg, und seiner frau Margarethe von Hirschhorn von Ruprecht I her 810 gulden, wofür derselbe Minneberg von Contze Monich, vogt zu Steinsberg, gelöst, 1000 gulden, welche der pfalzgraf des von Rosenberg tochter verschrieben, und 1000 gulden für sich, zusammen 2810 gulden, wofür ihm Minneberg als pfand bleibt.
entries.english: Rupert owes Conrad von Rosenberg, virestum of Heidelberg, and his wife Margarethe von Hirschhorn 810 guilders from Rupert I, for which the same Minneberg von Contze Monich, bailiff of Steinsberg, was redeemed, 1000 guilders, which the Count Palatine gave to Rosenberg's daughter, and 1000 guilders for himself, altogether 2810 guilders, for which Minneberg remains as collateral.
facts: Konrad von Rosenberg is titled Vitztum zu Heidelberg
Margarethe von Hirschhorn is spouse of Konrad von Rosenberg
Konrad von Rosenberg had a daughter who was promised money by the Pfalzgraf
Konrad von Rosenberg was creditor of Ruprecht for multiple debts
Konrad von Rosenberg held Minneberg as security for debts owed by Ruprecht
